retired.why: The Guest role was retired 2026-10-05 (backend 6459c35a, frontend 3c36a224); a stray guest reads as a viewer.
Assistant tasks are counted per month on every plan since 2026-09-29; Free is 20 a month (AssistantQuota.ts).
retired.instead: a monthly number of tasks (see the plans table)

retired.why: Chat mode was retired 2026-09-24; the AI tab is the agent only.
There are no modes any more; the agent is the only assistant, so it is never a named mode.

Auto-organization was retired 2026-09-06; workflows replace it. Exception: Settings still has a tab literally labelled "Auto Organization" (now only a hand-off screen that builds a workflow from old instructions), so the pages that list Settings tabs or explain the migration (getting-started/interface-overview, workflows/overview, account/settings-reference, account/members-and-roles) may name it.
The Organize with AI action belonged to auto-organization, retired 2026-09-06. The on-demand explorer action that remains is labelled "Organize this folder (⌘K)".
Team workspaces are priced per seat since 2026-09-15; there is no flat monthly workspace price.
Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint and Dropbox are connected drives the agent works in directly, not manual import/export only.
File requests are link-only; recipients upload through the request link. Email-reply fulfilment was removed and must never be offered.
Composio is not part of the product; integrations are first-party.
Which plans include a feature is the catalog's answer and changes with pricing; the generated table on Plans and pricing states it.
retired.instead: a plan that includes it (see [Plans and pricing](/account/plans-pricing))

retired.why: A personal workspace never becomes a team workspace; a team plan is a separate workspace created with Create team workspace.
retired.instead: create a team workspace (your personal workspace stays as it is)
